title: Resumed spend total with malformed receipts

request.goal: A paused broker resumes with PermitAuthority(ledger, max_cumulative_usd=0.8). The ledger hash chain verifies. What is cumulative_cost_usd after replay, and is the next permit issued or refused?

note.title: Operator note
note.text: Each of p-1..p-4 was issued and consumed before its receipt. The "0.1" receipt was hand-edited during an incident and re-chained.

pass: cumulative_cost_usd = 0.75: replay adds 0.25 and 0.5 and skips null and the string "0.1" (type is str). 0.75 < 0.8, so the next permit is issued.
**cumulative_cost_usd after replay = 0.75; the next permit is ISSUED.** Counted: 0.25 (p-1) + 0.5 (p-4) = **0.75**. True spend is 0.25 + 0.1 + 0.5 = **0.85**, so replay under-counts.
**cumulative_cost_usd after replay: 0.75. The next permit is issued, not refused.** Total = 0.25 + 0.5 = **0.75**.
fail: 0.85 including the 0.1 receipt, so the next permit is refused with cumulative_cap_exceeded.
cumulative_cost_usd = 0.85, so the next permit is refused; without the "0.1" receipt it would be 0.75.
